acceptance_criteria.given: NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_DATE is set to '2026-10-17' at build time
acceptance_criteria.when: a visitor loads any page containing the footer

acceptance_criteria.then: no element matching 'Built:' is present in the footer

acceptance_criteria.given: the footer is rendered with a build date present
acceptance_criteria.how: Compare the 'Built:' paragraph against the 'Last updated' paragraph — both should share text-sm and the zinc-600 / dark:zinc-400 colour pair
acceptance_criteria.then: the 'Built:' line uses the same text size and muted zinc colour as the 'Last updated' line immediately above it
acceptance_criteria.when: the page is inspected visually and via DevTools

assumptions.assumption: The YYYY-MM-DD format in the initial framing is intentional and does not need reformatting to DD MMM YYYY — DTS-04 §1 applies to customer-facing dates; this is build metadata.
Silently omitting the line when the env var is absent is the correct behaviour for local development.

clarified_description: Add a 'Built: YYYY-MM-DD' line to the site footer, showing the date the site was last built. The date is injected at build time via the NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_DATE environment variable. When the variable is absent (local development), the line is not rendered.

constraints.detail: NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_DATE must be set in the environment before `next build` runs. The build pipeline (CI or container build script) is responsible for providing it, e.g. NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_DATE=$(date -u +%F) next build.

deferred_decisions: Where in the build pipeline NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_DATE is set (package.json build script, CI workflow step, or next.config.ts env injection). The engineer should pick the approach that fits the container build described in ADR-0144.
must: WHEN NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_DATE is set WHILE the footer renders the system shall display the text 'Built: <value>' where <value> is the YYYY-MM-DD string from that variable.
IF NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_DATE is not set THEN the system shall not render any 'Built:' line in the footer.
The system shall style the build-date line to match the existing 'Last updated' paragraph in the footer (text-sm, muted zinc colour, mt-1 top margin).

non_functional.why_not: The build date is a static string baked in at build time; it adds no runtime computation or network call.
No new service dependency is introduced.
The value is a static YYYY-MM-DD string set in the build environment; it carries no secrets and is not derived from user input.
No new code paths that require logging or tracing.

non_functional.target: Plain-text paragraph; no ARIA attributes needed beyond what the footer landmark already provides.

non_functional.why_not: This is build metadata, not a customer-facing date display governed by DTS-04.

outcome: Every deployed build of the site shows its build date in the footer, making it immediately obvious which version is running without opening CI logs.
rationale: Using `NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_DATE` is the idiomatic Next.js pattern for build-time constants: the value is statically inlined by the compiler, so there is no runtime cost and no server-side logic needed. The footer already has a 'Last updated' paragraph (`mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400`); the new line sits below it in the same visual rhythm. DTS-04 (DD MMM YYYY) is not applied here because build metadata is not a customer-facing date. The change touches exactly two files: the component and its test.

risks.mitigation: Verify the 'Built:' line is visible in UAT before full release; add NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_DATE to the container build command as described in ADR-0144.
risks.title: Build date absent if NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_DATE not set in pipeline

swe_constraints: Read the build date from process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_DATE — this is the Next.js convention for build-time public constants.
Match the existing 'Last updated' paragraph styling exactly: className='mt-1 text-sm text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400'.
Do not pass the value through formatDate — render the raw YYYY-MM-DD string.
Render nothing when NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_DATE is undefined or an empty string.

touches.reason: Add the conditional 'Built: YYYY-MM-DD' paragraph below the existing 'Last updated' paragraph.
Existing footer test file; new AC1/AC2 tests added alongside existing ones.
